checks.question: Revise the supplied channel bracket for a new mounting pattern. Keep its 85 mm overall length, 50 mm width, 66.4 mm side-wall height and 4 mm plate thickness. Replace the existing pattern with three diameter-4.3 mm holes in the base and three in each upright. Measured from the left outer end face, base-hole X positions are 9.16, 42.5 and 75.84 mm, all at the width centre. Measured from the bottom face, upright-hole heights are 9.16, 35.2 and 61.24 mm, again centred across the width. Increase both triangular corner-gusset thicknesses from 5.3 to 7.0 mm, symmetrically about the width centre, retaining their triangular profiles. Drill the holes through any gusset material they cross so none ends blindly. Fill obsolete holes rather than leaving two patterns.
